title: Money: Naira Notes and Coins
seo_title: Money – Primary 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Recognise naira notes and coins; count money up to ₦500; add amounts of money; give change. (summary of the NERDC Primary 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 2 maths worksheets on Nigerian money: naira notes and coins up to ₦500, counting money, which is worth more, shopping and change. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Our money is the naira (₦). We have coins (₦1, ₦2) and notes (₦5, ₦10, ₦20, ₦50, ₦100, ₦200, ₦500).
  • Count the note with the biggest value first, then count on.
  • Change is what you get back.

Examples

Example

₦100 + ₦50 + ₦20

Count on

Answer: ₦170

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting the number of notesCount the value of each note.
Adding to find changeTake away to find change.
Forgetting ₦Write the naira sign.
